Cross-Platform Compatibility

Meta Mask is compatible with both Android and Windows, making it easy for users to connect securely across their preferred devices, whether they are using a smartphone or a computer.

Country Selection

Users can select specific countries for their VPN connection, enabling flexible access tailored to regional requirements.

Secure Connection

Meta Mask encrypts all data exchanged, protecting your connections across all online activities. It ensures privacy and security, safeguarding against breaches, surveillance, and external threats. Whether accessing government services or browsing, your data remains secure.

Masked VPN Activities & No Logging

More than just masking connection status, Meta Mask ensures complete privacy by concealing all VPN-related activities. With its strict No Log Policy, this added layer of security guarantees that every VPN task remains fully confidential and untraceable.
